newsitem.title: UK: BOE says proposals will help on inflation aims.
newsitem.headline: BOE says proposals will help on inflation aims.

text.p: The Bank of England (BOE) said on Tuesday proposals by Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown on BOE status will help ensure inflation objectives are met.

A BOE spokesman, reading a prepared statement, said Bank of England governor Eddie George, welcomed the proposals. Brown said he would give the BOE its own exchange reserves to help steer policy and that a new nine-member monetary policy committee would hold a meeting in June.
"The governor welcomes the chancellor's proposals. These new arrangements will help to ensure that the government's objectives of low inflation are met," the statement said.
